import pandas as pd

# File paths for source tables
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_5/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_5/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_5/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_5/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_5/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_5/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_5/training_6.csv",
]

# Read all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Union all source tables by concatenation
df_union = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure columns have correct types as per target schema
df_union['nombre'] = df_union['nombre'].astype(str)
df_union['n_concursados'] = df_union['n_concursados'].astype(int)
df_union['n_aprobados'] = df_union['n_aprobados'].astype(int)
df_union['año'] = df_union['año'].astype(int)

# The target key is (nombre, año), so drop duplicates on these keys keeping the first occurrence
df_final = df_union.drop_duplicates(subset=['nombre', 'año'], keep='first')

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
df_final = df_final[['nombre', 'n_concursados', 'n_aprobados', 'año']]

# Write the final target table to the specified path without the index
df_final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_5/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
